summary: Dependency-free SVG scatter (and bubble) chart: points on two linear numeric axes, series distinguished by color and marker shape, keyboard navigation between points, and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Showing the relationship between two numeric quantities (floor area and revenue, effort and value).
Adding a third quantity with the bubble size (size).
whenNotToUse: Trends across ordered categories or over time: use LineChart.
Comparing quantities across categories: use BarChart.
Thousands of points or interactive zoom: use a dedicated library.

props.name: series
props.description: Point series; label names the point (otherwise its position is used), size turns it into a bubble.

props.name: xLabel / yLabel
props.description: Horizontal and vertical axis titles; they are also the data table headers.

props.name: xFormatOptions / yFormatOptions
props.description: Format of the values and ticks of each axis (currency, percent, compact…) in the current locale.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: description
props.description: Visible description below the title (period, unit, source).

props.name: height
props.description: Chart height in px; the width follows the container.

props.name: showGrid
props.description: Horizontal and vertical gridlines at the ticks.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Legend; with multiple series each entry is a button that shows/hides the series.

props.name: hiddenSeries / defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Ids of the hidden series (controlled / uncontrolled).

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called when the legend changes the visible series.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid fills markers and bubbles with gradients and glows using the same theme colors; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of the <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area (then to the legend and the table button).
Next point in ascending x order (across all visible series): shows and announces series, point, and values.

accessibility: <figure> + <figcaption> structure; the chart area is a focusable role="group", named by the title and described by a hint on using the arrow keys.
Keyboard navigation announces "series — point: x, y" in an aria-live="polite" region; the active point is enlarged and marked by guide lines on both axes.
The SVG is decorative (aria-hidden): all points are in the table (point, series, x, y) opened by the "Show data table" button.
Series don’t rely on color alone: the marker shape changes per series; the legend uses aria-pressed.
In forced-colors mode markers and bubbles use CanvasText, the active point Highlight.
responsive: The width is measured with ResizeObserver (falls back to 560 px in SSR); the number of X-axis ticks adapts and labels are thinned out when there isn’t enough space.
Entrance animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Series colors: tokens --dc-color-data-1…6, assigned cyclically; grid and axes use --dc-color-border-subtle and --dc-color-border-strong.
Bubbles: radius from 4 to 18 px proportional to the square root of size (the area grows with the value).
Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) fills the markers and fades the bubbles toward --dc-color-accent-default.
commonMistakes: Using ScatterChart for categories (months, names): the X axis is numeric and linear.
Forgetting xLabel and yLabel: without axis titles the values are ambiguous, even in the table.
Passing values already converted to a radius in size: size is a quantity; the square-root scale is applied by the component.

examples.name: Bubbles
examples.title: Bubble chart
examples.description: size controls the area of each bubble.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Filled markers and glows with the theme colors.

limits: Linear axes only (no logarithmic scale) and no trend line.
No zoom or virtualization: designed for tens/hundreds of points; overlapping points stay overlapped.
Label width is estimated (no text measurement).
The SVG is still drawn left to right in RTL.
